capabilities: Search USDA and Open Food Facts by text or barcode
Log foods with quantity, unit and meal to a CSV food log
Render daily food tables with calorie and macro totals in daily notes
Save custom foods, portions, and multi-food combos in a My foods note
Show exercise calories and net intake from imported activity notes
extras: Installation is manual (copy files into .obsidian/plugins) and the README says 'from the latest release once there is one'. Warns in detail about CSV sync conflicts with Obsidian Sync, iCloud, Dropbox, Syncthing and Git. Without a USDA key it uses the shared DEMO_KEY, limited to about 10 lookups per hour per network. Includes a disclaimer that nutrition data may be wrong and the plugin is not medical or dietary advice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log what you eat or see daily calorie and macro totals inside your notes.

relations.evidence: Turn on daily notes in the Periodic Notes plugin or Obsidian's core Daily notes plugin.
If you import workouts with Physical Activity Importer, each day's log also shows Exercise and Net rows

summary: Food tracker that searches USDA and Open Food Facts, logs meals to a CSV file, and renders daily calorie and macro totals in daily notes.
